'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[Palestinian political violence]]
***Two [[Israel|Israelis]] from [[Ashdod]] are killed in an attack in [[Huwara]] in the occupied [[West Bank]]. *[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[19 August 2023 Chernihiv missile strike|Chernihiv missile strike]]
***At least seven people are killed and 129 others are injured in a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[ballistic missile]] strike on a theater in [[Chernihiv]] hosting a meeting of [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|military]] and engineers at an exhibition on the use of consumer [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|drones]] in the conflict. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Pacific hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Hilary (2023)|Hurricane Hilary]]
***A man dies after being swept by a current in [[Baja California Sur]] while attempting to cross a stream in his vehicle to [[emergency evacuation|evacuate]] the area. [https://www.laprensalatina.com/man-dies-trying-to-cross-stream-in-vehicle-in-northern-mexico/amp/ (La Prensa Latina Media)]
*[[2023 Canadian wildfires]]
**35,000 people are ordered to evacuate in [[British Columbia]] due to wildfires, with another 30,000 people under evacuation alerts. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/bc-wildfires-evacuations-latest-aug-19-1.6941544 (CBC News)]
*Nine members of the [[Indian Army]] are killed and another is seriously injured after their vehicle falls into a gorge near [[Leh]], [[Ladakh]], [[India]]. [https://www.economictimes.com/news/defence/tragic-road-accident-in-ladakh-9-soldiers-killed-as-army-vehicle-plunges-into-gorge/videoshow/102862574.cms (Mirror Now via ''The Economic Times'')]
*The [[Hellenic Coast Guard|Greek Coast Guard]] rescues 60 migrants in [[Inflatable boat|inflatable dinghies]] who were attempting to cross from [[Turkey]] to the eastern [[Aegean Sea]] islands in two separate incidents. '''Law and crime'''
*[[Human rights in Japan]]
**A [[Government of Japan|government]] panel investigating [[harassment]] cases in the [[Japan Self-Defense Forces|military]] and the [[Ministry of Defense (Japan)|defense ministry]] finds widespread cover-ups and reluctance among supervisors to address these cases. [https://apnews.com/article/japan-military-harassment-report-coverup-0ef14ed928eab6e09922561f48fb54bd (AP)]
*[[Oupeye]], [[Liège Province]], [[Belgium]], bans gatherings of more than four people following [[riot]]s. The riots spread to the neighboring commune of [[Herstal]]. A school and various homes were damaged and garbage can fires were reported. [https://www.7sur7.be/belgique/les-rassemblements-de-plus-de-quatre-personnes-interdits-jusqua-nouvel-ordre-a-oupeye~a0ebbcee/ (7Sur7)] [https://www.lesoir.be/532080/article/2023-08-20/deces-dun-jeune-lors-dun-controle-de-police-deuxieme-nuit-daffrontement-avec-la (Le Soir)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Luna programme]]
**[[Roscosmos]] spacecraft [[Luna 25]] crashes into the moon after moving into an unpredictable orbit during the transition to a pre-landing orbit. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/space/russias-luna-25-moon-mission-fails-what-you-need-know-2023-08-20/ (Reuters)] 

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 FIFA Women's World Cup]]
**[[Sweden women's national football team|Sweden]] [[2023 FIFA Women's World Cup knockout stage#Third place play-off|defeats]] co-host [[Australia women's national soccer team|Australia]] 2–0 in the third place play-off. Sweden defends its [[podium finish]] from [[2019 FIFA Women's World Cup|the previous edition]], while despite the loss, Australia records its best finish at the [[FIFA Women's World Cup|World Cup]]. [https://www.foxsports.com/stories/soccer/womens-world-cup-2023-top-plays-sweden-australia (Fox Sports)]
*[[2023 Leagues Cup]]
**[[Major League Soccer]] club [[Inter Miami CF]] wins the [[Leagues Cup]], [[2023 Leagues Cup final|10–9]], in a [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]], making it their first title since joining the league in 2020.
